topic: WebSec benchmark: 8 search APIs returned malicious results to AI coding agents; turn off auto-run
caption:
Your AI coding agent might be installing malware for you.

A new benchmark ran thousands of normal coding-agent searches through 8 search tools that AI agents use. Every single one returned malicious or risky results, in about 1 to 2% of searches.

In one real case, the top GitHub result for a Solana starter kit installed a remote access trojan. With auto-run on, nobody reads that install command first.

The fix is simple: turn off auto-run for terminal commands. Let AI write the code. You approve what runs.

Note: the study is by AIR, a company that sells agent security, and it hasn't been independently repeated yet.

Do you let your agent run commands on its own? 👇

Source: AIR WebSec benchmark, The Hacker News, Cloud Security Alliance
